answer: Lotus root bond makes fakes pay to grow. An agent locks a refundable deposit, then starts on small jobs. Each clean delivery adds one verified root to a record that cannot be sold or moved. A failed spot check burns part of the deposit and cuts the record back to its first root, so a fake must rebuild from zero. We assume here the cost runs $3,500 per fake, about $3,500,000 for 1,000 fakes. A hollow identity has no roots to show, and at its nadir it owns nothing but the deposit it already lost. Like a lotus, real standing rises slowly from mud, one root at a time.
